Hi Nora —

Quick check-in on the expansion opportunity we discussed last month. Finance is doing a forecast pass for Q4 and needs a clean signal from Sales + CS on stage, ARR uplift, and realistic close window. Can you confirm the following so we can tidy the pipe?

- Target expansion ARR (net new recurring ARR) you expect by go-live
- Target close date range (we currently have 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31)

- Primary success metrics (usage seat count / throughput / response time SLAs)

Thanks for the outline. Short CS readiness update and notes for Finance:

Current CS view (summary):

- Confirmed expansion ARR: $225k (matches Sales)
- Enablement plan: kickoff week of 10/04, 5 enablement sessions (recorded), self-service guides + 2 dedicated office hours for first 30 days.
